headline: Bitcoin fell below $73,000 for the first time since August after hot US inflation data lifted bond yields above 5%; MSCI's decision on Strategy and other crypto-treasury firms comes Wednesday evening ET.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko and alternative.me at about 2:55pm ET Tue 10 Nov (02:55 Bangkok Wed 11 Nov). Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Hot inflation sends bitcoin to its lowest since August as yields top 5%
stories.summary: US consumer prices rose faster than forecast in October. Bitcoin dropped below $73,000 for the first time since August and the 10-year Treasury yield rose above 5%. Traders now expect the Fed to raise rates on 9 December; higher rates tend to weigh on assets like crypto that pay no interest.
points: Prices rose 0.4% in October against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per BLS and CoinDesk.
Bitcoin lost $73,000 for the first time since August, per CoinDesk, touching a low of $72,787 on Bitstamp, per Bitcoin.com News.
No source now prices a December hold: CoinDesk cited CME FedWatch at 85% for a quarter-point hike and 15% for a half-point; 24/7 Wall St cited 89% for a quarter-point.
The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 15 basis points to 5.015%, per CoinDesk.
About $705M of positions were forcibly closed in 24 hours, 82% of them bets on higher prices, per TokenPost.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds keep losing money, and public companies are selling coins
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin and ether funds had net outflows again on Monday. Separately, public companies, mostly bitcoin miners, have sold billions of dollars of bitcoin this year, adding to supply.
points: Monday 9 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $201M net, including $213.2M from BlackRock's IBIT; it was the seventh straight day of outflows for spot bitcoin ETFs, per Le Private Banker.
Monday 9 Nov: US spot ether ETFs lost about $184.5M, per SoSoValue via crypto.news.
14 public companies have sold 108,247 BTC, about $8.08B, so far in 2026, per Lookonchain via crypto.news.
MARA sold 40,581 BTC this year, per Lookonchain, and used $750M to repay loans backed by its bitcoin, per its Q3 letter as reported by crypto.news.

sources.label: Le Private Banker: seventh day of ETF outflows

stories.title: MSCI decides Wednesday whether to drop Strategy and other crypto-treasury firms
stories.summary: On Wednesday evening ET, MSCI announces its November index changes, which could remove companies whose main business is holding crypto, such as Strategy. Funds that copy the index would then need to adjust their holdings of the stock, but removal would not require Strategy to sell its bitcoin.
points: Results come shortly after 11:00pm CET Wed 11 Nov (about 5pm ET, 05:00 Thursday Bangkok); changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
MSCI's list of possible deletions names Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi, per crypto.news.
Strategy held 848,517 BTC bought for a total of $64.02B as of 25 Oct, per crypto.news.
Removal would not require Strategy to sell its bitcoin; funds that replicate the index would need to adjust their portfolios, per crypto.news.

sources.label: crypto.news: Strategy faces 11 Nov index decision

briefs.title: Big banks fund a joint dollar stablecoin
briefs.summary: A venture backed by 21 institutions including Goldman, Citi, BofA and Wells Fargo has about $270M in commitments and targets a launch in the first half of 2027, per Bloomberg via crypto.news.

briefs.title: Binance warns of an iPhone flaw affecting wallets
briefs.summary: An iOS bug called "worse_query" could let malicious apps read other apps' files, including seed phrases; no thefts are confirmed, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and others back the CFTC in court
briefs.summary: They filed a brief supporting the CFTC's approval of stock perpetual futures, which a lawsuit is challenging; a judge denied a restraining order on 3 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: SEC and CFTC plan to push ahead on crypto rules
briefs.summary: The agencies plan to write crypto rules under their existing powers after the CLARITY Act failed in the Senate, per American Banker.

briefs.title: Zcash falls despite Grayscale ad push
briefs.summary: Grayscale ran a Zcash ad campaign and raised its grant pledge to $1M, but ZEC fell about 13% and its ETF about 12%, per The Block.

briefs.title: BitMine keeps buying ether
briefs.summary: BitMine bought 9,587 ETH, taking it to 6,070,092 ETH, about 4.97% of supply, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Miner-maker Canaan's sales collapse
briefs.summary: Canaan's Q3 revenue fell 90% to $14.5M as mining-rig sales slumped, per The Block.

briefs.title: Securitize shares jump
briefs.summary: Securitize rose 41% to $9.86 after Q3 results, a Citi upgrade and a $50M buyback, per CoinDesk.
